evidence.claim: For a classical code correcting t errors, the review states the distance relation d = 2t + 1.
A general coherent single-qubit error can be expanded in the Pauli basis and reduced to components from {I, X, Z, XZ}; stabilizer measurement digitizes the error into correctable Pauli classes.
For the two-qubit detection code, the syndrome table assigns syndrome 1 to single X errors and syndrome 0 to identity or two-qubit X errors.
